title: ROI-Reasoning: Rational Optimization for Inference via Pre-Computation Meta-Cognition
abstract: arXiv:2601.03822v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can achieve strong reasoning performance with sufficient computation, but they do not inherently know how much computation a task requires. We study budgeted inference-time reasoning for multiple problems under a strict global token constraint and formulate it as an Ordered Stochastic Multiple-Choice Knapsack Problem (OS-MCKP). This perspective highlights a meta-cognitive requirement---anticipating problem difficulty and allocating computation strategically. We propose ROI-Reasoning, a two-stage framework that endows LLMs with intrinsic, budget-aware rationality. First, Meta-Cognitive Fine-Tuning teaches models to predict reasoning cost levels and decide whether a problem is worth attempting before generation. Next, Rationality-Aware Reinforcement Learning optimizes sequential decision making under a hard token budget, allowing models to learn long-horizon allocation strategies. Experiments across mathema

translated_title: ROI-Reasoning：通过预计算元认知实现推理的理性优化
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在具备充足计算资源时能够取得强大的推理性能，但它们本身并不知道一项任务究竟需要多少计算量。我们研究了在严格的全局 token 约束下针对多个问题的预算化推理时推理，并将其形式化为一个有序随机多选择背包问题。这一视角凸显了一种元认知需求——预判问题难度并策略性地分配计算。我们提出了 ROI-Reasoning，这是一个两阶段框架，赋予大语言模型内在的、预算感知的理性。首先，元认知微调教导模型预测推理成本水平，并在生成之前判断一个问题是否值得尝试。其次，理性感知强化学习在硬性 token 预算下优化序贯决策，使模型能够学习长视野的分配策略。实验在数学（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出 ROI-Reasoning 两阶段框架，通过元认知微调与理性感知强化学习，让大语言模型在严格 token 预算下学会预判问题难度并理性分配推理计算资源。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ROI-Reasoning, a two-stage framework combining Meta-Cognitive Fine-Tuning and Rationality-Aware Reinforcement Learning that enables LLMs to anticipate problem difficulty and rationally allocate reasoning computation under strict global token budgets.
